## Key facts
- 10 H hardness, Graphene coating
- 800 nanometres thick, Graphene 10H
- 5 years' warranty on 3M underbody protection
- 2 studios, Kottivakkam and Kovilambakkam

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is DP Car Spa?
No. 3, Senthamaraikannan Street, Venkateswara Nagar, Kottivakkam, ECR, Chennai 600 041 (Lane before Kottivakkam KFC).

### What facilities does DP Car Spa have?
Nano-ceramic coating, Graphene coating (10H & N1), Garware PPF, Door edge PPF, Car polishing, Alloy polish, Foam wash, Bike spa, Bike nano-ceramic, Anti-germ interior enhancement, 3M underbody protection, Silencer coating, Car sun film, Car wrapping, Car accessories.

### What warranty do you give?
5 years on 3M underbody protection, and 1 or 5 years on sun film depending on the film you choose. Nano-ceramic coating also comes with warranty.

### Do you work on bikes?
Yes: bike nano-ceramic coating, bike polish and bike foam wash.

### How do I book DP Car Spa?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 89399 67611.
